page.overview:
Who is Blender?

Blender was an Ankylosaurus once present in the United States. At one point he met Bumpy who became his mate. However at an unknown time, Blender was captured and sent to Biosyn sanctuary.

Blender was first mentioned by Sammy when Bumpy laid the egg. She also mentions that Bumpy would sometimes run off from the ranch to meet him.

Blender protects Smoothie from getting stepped on by a Monolophosaurus, meeting him for the first time and recognizing him as his son before reuniting with Bumpy, also recognizing her.

Blender is seen happily living with Bumpy and Smoothie in Biosyn Valley after the incident.
